query_trigger: lexical upgrades replace boring words a lot of very important
compact_knowledge: Academic Precision: Replace 'a lot of' with 'a substantial proportion of / an abundance of'; replace 'very important' with 'of paramount importance / pivotal'; replace 'bad effect' with 'detrimental impact / adverse repercussions'; replace 'big problem' with 'formidable dilemma / pressing challenge'; replace 'help' with 'facilitate / bolster / expedite'.

query_trigger: phrasal verbs formal alternatives writing task 2
compact_knowledge: In IELTS Academic Writing, prefer single Latinate verbs over informal phrasal verbs: 'account for' -> 'constitute/explain'; 'bring about' -> 'engender/precipitate'; 'look into' -> 'investigate'; 'give up' -> 'relinquish'; 'put forward' -> 'postulate/propose'; 'deal with' -> 'address/confront'.

query_trigger: discourse linkers transitions cohesive devices furthermore
compact_knowledge: Natural Cohesive Markers: 'To put this into perspective', 'By the same token', 'Notwithstanding that assertion', 'In stark contrast to', 'Consequently, this precipitates', 'A compelling case in point is...'. Avoid overused cliches like 'every coin has two sides' or 'in a nutshell'.
